# Cncf Viettel Kubernetes Engine Reviewer

Review Viettel Kubernetes Engine using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Viettel Kubernetes Engine is a fully managed Kubernetes service that enables you to deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters on the Viettel Cloud platform.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
